purpose: training-only automatic buffer candidate selection and observational CPU GPU correspondence
core_inputs: native buffer creation and mapped-upload metadata

selection.read_evidence: explicit binding OR shader-readable transition; transition alone does not prove a shader read

capture.range: prefix of the actually observed destination write range
capture.moment: immediately after CopyBufferRegion in the same native command list
capture.completion: observer fence signalled on the actual submission queue after ExecuteCommandLists
capture.CPU_snapshot: tagged with the same write operation; private RW windows, excluding registered mapped buffers

identity.resource: monotonic creation id, never a hard-coded pointer
identity.range: destination offset, write size, sampled size
identity.operation: unique write id plus source resource/generation/offset
identity.command: native list identity plus recording incarnation
identity.GPU_completion: queue id, required fence value, observed completed value

confirmation.unknown_or_ambiguous: retained as hypotheses; never authorizes replacement

invalidation: unknown alias scope for selected buffers
missing CPU region or changed holdout bytes

budgets.critical_lifecycle_events: retained for selected bindings during the bounded training session

coverage_limits: mapped UPLOAD to buffer copy writes only, not arbitrary UAV or texture writes
explicit bindings and state intent do not resolve bindless shader accesses
CPU snapshots are observations, not allocation ownership or cross-thread synchronization proofs
fixture routes native API events using temporary backend instrumentation; general game DLL deployment is not implemented here
native alias/recreation stress was not added; lifecycle protocol tests cover rejection and native shutdown demonstrates destruction invalidation
